description: This is a Dart source file defining the Document class, which models a stored file with metadata within a wallet application. It includes fields like id, folderId, name, filePath, mimeType, tags, createdAt, and updatedAt. The class provides methods to construct an instance from a database map, convert it back to a map for database storage, and create modified copies.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: An immutable class representing a file stored in the wallet, with associated metadata such as name, filepath, MIME type, tags, and timestamps.

methods.name: Document.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Document instance from a database map.

methods.name: Document.toMap
methods.description: Converts the Document instance into a map suitable for database storage, optionally including the id.

methods.name: Document.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Document with specified fields replaced with new values.
